title: Conditional scan with carry
statement: Given a set $\Gamma$, a predicate $\operatorname{top}:\Gamma\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and a function $\operatorname{next}:\Gamma\to\Gamma$, define a transition on a Boolean carry $c$ and symbol $\gamma$. If $c$ is true, it returns $(\operatorname{top}(\gamma),\operatorname{next}(\gamma))$; if $c$ is false, it returns $(\mathrm{false},\gamma)$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean carry and a symbol in $\Gamma$
